baseball.name: Hip Load Isolation
baseball.description: P1: Slow back-hip load only, hands frozen — feel balanced loaded back hip before any hand movement. Mirror or video.
baseball.eliminatesEffect: no separation, weak contact, late swings

baseball.name: Load Sequence Pause
baseball.description: P1→P2: Hip load → 1-count freeze → hand load. Locks correct order so hands never fire before hips.
baseball.fixesCause: hands and hips firing in wrong order

baseball.name: Sideways Landing Check
baseball.description: P3: Stride and freeze at landing — chest + shoulders square to plate, body sideways, both feet down. Photograph or video.
baseball.eliminatesEffect: can't reach outside pitch, jammed inside

baseball.name: Elbow-First Fulcrum
baseball.description: P4: Knob acts as fulcrum — drive back elbow forward FIRST while hands stay back. Tee or front toss. Hands must trail elbow.

baseball.name: Catch The Ball
baseball.description: P4: Soft toss focus — line your hands up with the ball and try to "catch it" with your hands. Extension comes after contact.

baseball.name: No-Stride Power
baseball.description: P1: Stanceless reps — prove that hip load alone produces power. Removes stride variable to expose true hip-load quality.
baseball.fixesCause: relying on stride for power instead of hip load
